title: Rabbi Yehoshua ben Hyrcanus

paragraphs: [Mishnah Sotah 5:5](https://www.sefaria.org/Mishnah_Sotah.5.5) says: “On that day Rabbi Yehoshua ben Hyrcanus expounded: Job served the Holy One, blessed be He, solely out of love.” Rabbi Yehoshua said: “Who will uncover the dust from your eyes, Rabban Yohanan ben Zakkai? Yehoshua, your student’s student…” ([Rashi](https://www.sefaria.org/Rashi_on_Sotah.27b.14.3) explains that he was Rabbi Akiva’s student.) He therefore lived during the dispute between Rabban Gamliel and Rabbi Yehoshua: [Berakhot 28a](https://www.sefaria.org/Berakhot.28a.4) explains that “on that day” refers to the day Rabban Gamliel was removed from the patriarchate.[^1]

notes.text: Yehoshua ben Hyrcanus gives the teaching about Job. The second Yehoshua addresses his late teacher, Rabban Yochanan ben Zakkai. [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=1759&lang=en) distinguishes the speakers and also cites Rashi’s explanation of the teacher–student relationship.
